title: Early Learning
before:
Vision 

All of Maine’s children are prepared to transition into their adolescent years as healthy, engaged, and inquisitive learners. 

Mission 

The Maine Department of Education’s Early Learning Team collaborates with all stakeholders to promote the well-being of the whole child to support children’s learning opportunities from birth through the early elementary grades.  

Upcoming Events

 

News & Updates

 

 

Public Preschool

The Early Learning Team at the Maine Department of Education is happy to offer support and information to SAUs who currently offer public Pre-K programs and to those who are looking to implement programs.

notes: 2 section headers — too few for a contents list.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 1 heading is plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Put the card titles on one level
decisions.why: 6 card titles are written at a level copied from an example rather than chosen — h5 on a page whose sections are h2. Only the number changes.

decisions.label: Run a label into the line it labels
decisions.why: 2 labels sit alone in a paragraph with the sentence it labels in the next one — two blocks, two margins and a line break to say one thing. Down a list of exclusions that reads as a column of orphaned labels. Run in with a colon, which is how a term and its definition are set. The only character added is the colon.

decisions.label: Put the content under its own heading
decisions.why: "Upcoming Events" had nothing beneath it, and the content that belongs to it was written above the heading instead of below. Nothing is added or removed; it moves under its own title.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.

decisions.label: Retire the old banner graphic
